plan.title: Auto title appears across buyer and vendor views

steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen.
Enable eRFX project creation for the test company.
Allow a vendor to be added during event creation.
Configure the event as an RFQ without manually setting its title.
Apply the RFQ pricing template so the product sheet is available.
Add the CYLINDER product and set its requested quantity to 10.
Set the delivery location that should appear in the automatic title.
Confirm the selected delivery location was retained.
Confirm the RFQ pricing sheet rendered with the expected fields.
Add one QA test vendor for the vendor-portal verification.
Commit the required 30-minute schedule.
Publish the RFQ and confirm the publish flow.
Confirm the buyer reached the published project page.
Verify the generated project title is displayed on the project page.
Confirm the automatic title identifies the event as an RFQ.
Confirm the automatic title includes the selected delivery location.
Remember the generated title text before leaving the project page.
Open the buyer's events list.
Confirm the events list rendered successfully.
Open the Live events tab where the published event should appear.
Confirm this plan's published event appears in the Live list.
Compare the remembered project title with the title shown in the Live list.
Open the invited QA vendor's supplier-portal session while preserving the buyer session.
Open this plan's event in the vendor portal overview.
Confirm the vendor portal shows the RFQ title marker.
Confirm the vendor portal shows the delivery-location portion of the title.
Compare the vendor portal title with the exact title remembered from the project page.
